title: Complete source-bound full-stage preparation with separate mode plans
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Complete the five joined **SOURCE-prerequisite exits** selected in Pro v26: exact caller-source closure, static version compatibility, complete payload and separate proposed mode plans, actual non-admitting preparation/finalisation, and independent whole-result agreement.

Recover the authentic `run_controls_v1.py` (6,394 bytes, SHA-256 `519813f0aca56dfd083449940446e8e719b37b70a3ba195d0eab7d7ae6437bcc`) through the pre-existing sealed template map and its actual negative-receiver consumer. Preserve its 169+33/41-context contract; do not alias v5. All 57 owner-source occurrences and all 259 mandatory payload destinations are retained. Three gzip evidence containers are copied and hashed opaquely.

The existing constructor now authenticates the joined manifest/compatibility/selection snapshot, requires exactly the referenced body-pool hashes, validates distinct proposed normal/optimized producer plans, and binds the held preparation parent and stage name before acquisition. Existing first-error, exclusive I/O, readback, quarantine and finish/abort machinery is retained.

**This completes source preparation only.** Original S06.03, real receiver/bootstrap admission, C07 lifetime/currentness, full C05, authentic V03 and the complete original runtime schedule remain unqualified. Every runtime/full-qualification claim remains false; proposed generations/nonces remain unissued and unreserved. Original weighted completion remains **43.5% (22/49 activities)**, with 2/10 stage gates, 1/10 overall milestones and the original 24-component/52-helper denominators. New original-activity credit: zero.

## Task and overlap

Explicit user-assigned C05/V03 prerequisites. Canonical base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; this update fast-forwards prior PR head `6460b7e9022c503b6c2d7c732cc362160646b208` to **`67f57119a75bf1f0637aebc6c080c121132912f4`**, tree `5c70797c84c014bb507a4523a06895b559e685f6`.

Add a self-contained versioned [successor-v26 archive](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67f57119a75bf1f0637aebc6c080c121132912f4/research/h25-fresh-sc-constructor/successor-v26/README.md) within the existing package. Preserve all 55 previous non-README file identities and all prior commits; the root README retains its historical text. The successor includes the full opaque input pool, exact source/review records, new raw results and scoped archive-integrity instructions.

Reuse [PR #6587](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6587)'s caller/source evidence, [PR #6553](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6553)'s corrected selection, and this PR's existing constructor. PR #6549's conditional guard remains separate. Bounded all-state/all-contributor searches for the exact binding/interface and updated C05 work found no additional applicable replacement; that is not a global novelty or code-absence claim.

Scope is refined from a held component to completed joined source preparation. No original caller/parent/domain/closure body, source cap, producer phase, native algorithm or scientific acceptance criterion is changed. Group01's three native builds remain distinct from the variant's two ordered builds; none was executed here.

## Validation

One independently reviewed serial invocation exercised **22 new cases per mode, 44 observations**, including one full inert preparation in normal mode and one in optimized mode. All four child attempts returned zero, with no timeout, overflow or stderr. The 17 predecessor cases remain retained evidence and were **not rerun**.

Both stages contain exactly **259 files, 38 directories and 20,496,867 bytes**, with matching hashes/modes and successful final closure. Independent review checked 518 distinct installed file inodes, 277 exact source/cold-copy inputs, both external finalisations and the durable parent acknowledgement. Runtime-owned proposed paths remain absent. The 246-body opaque pool contains 20,351,614 bytes; deduplication never removes an installation occurrence.

Whole-result review SHA-256: `f715f92af2ed1362bd78a09a2d703992645f4b48509d0c0a17a4ddea7cc2c3b4`. Parent acknowledgement SHA-256: `a016289dcb4ac13ab7d6b207f3c0f9a85d94b094ce5d9cf35542a8296ff8c5a1`.

The reviewed preparation envelope permits the required 16,995,263-byte opaque file within the unchanged 64 MiB per-file ceiling; raw stdout/stderr remain separately capped at 1 MiB. Children retain 15-second wall/CPU and 1 GiB address-space limits. No original module was imported/extracted for execution, no gzip was decoded, and no compiler/native/target/policy operation occurred.

Measured outer invocation: 19.047001973 seconds wall, 4.886459 seconds CPU; cumulative child peak RSS 72,020 KiB, not an aggregate sampled-memory measurement. Conservative new policy debit: **20 seconds**, including postchecks. Supplemental ledger: **135.890533479 seconds**; recorded canonical ledger remains **94.550533479 seconds**. Complete preparation/Pro/agent/review/network/publication/final-metadata physical costs remain `OPEN_NOT_ZERO`; no new budget.

The exact executed command and raw receipts are archived. Frozen preparation destinations are absolute and retained. Do not blindly replay into existing outputs or repin another directory: another-root execution requires a newly reviewed binding. Use the archive README's checksum command for read-only integrity. Low-level attempt `INCOMPLETE` labels and intermediate ledger snapshots remain unchanged; terminal acceptance comes from the verified final wrapper ledger, parent acknowledgement and whole-result review.

Source authoring froze at 14:58:43 UTC; independent review closed at 15:10:11; the source round closed at 15:10:51, before its fixed 15:11:55 stop. Subsequent work is frozen publication only. Exact-head hosted outcomes will be recorded in the delivery comment; archival planning checks do not execute this candidate.

## Credit

Retain all original source licences/notices, original and predecessor attribution, Chris R/Clear1nsight, Douglas R. Colkitt, unpaidmoon/Cursor-Grok and the original upstream manuscript authors. Prepared with substantial ChatGPT Pro, OpenAI Codex and GPT-6.1-sol Max implementation/independent-review assistance. These are scoped AI reviews and finite observations, not human or proof-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

- Qualify the unchanged actual F4/A4 and current owner/bootstrap requirements in both original modes. First bind genuine capabilities, custody/lifetime, currentness, IO/EX and the complete runtime schedule; prepared files and proposed DATA are insufficient.
- Complete C05's independently approved current project/system-header/include/macro/compiler/specs/linker/dependent-library witness closure. Original native and scientific execution gates remain open.
- Preserve the [canonical PR #6321 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321#issuecomment-6592212681) and [discussion #1166 pointer](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19363343). No goal-service resume, merge, automation or new research round follows from this contribution.
